name: Blow Your House Down
oracle_text: Up to three target creatures can't block this turn. Destroy any of them that are Walls.
flavor_text:
"You think these walls will protect you? My, you have a dim view of the power of the wilds."
—Marawen, barrow witch

name: Baleful Stare
oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You draw a card for each Mountain and red card in it.
flavor_text: "Though there is little to be learned from your dust and stones, I shall wring them dry nevertheless."

name: Withering Gaze
oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You draw a card for each Forest and green card in it.
flavor_text: "Nature cares not for the knowledge to be gained from its study. Better to bleed it dry, lest its potential be wasted on lizards and leaves."

name: Whirlwind Denial
oracle_text: For each spell and ability your opponents control, counter it unless its controller pays {4}.

name: Split the Party
oracle_text: Choose target player. Return half the creatures they control to their owner's hand, rounded up.

name: Eunuchs' Intrigues
oracle_text: Target opponent chooses a creature they control. Other creatures they control can't block this turn.
flavor_text: Taking control of powerful court positions one by one, eunuchs eventually brought on the fall of the Han dynasty, leading to the chaos of the Three Kingdoms.

name: Goblin War Cry
oracle_text: Target opponent chooses a creature they control. Other creatures they control can't block this turn.
flavor_text:
"Goblins cry, soldiers fly.
Stones fly, soldiers die!"

name: Book Burning
oracle_text: Any player may have Book Burning deal 6 damage to them. If no one does, target player mills six cards.
flavor_text: The wizard's spellbook was full of burning questions.

name: Coalition Victory
oracle_text: You win the game if you control a land of each basic land type and a creature of each color.
flavor_text:
"You can build a perfect machine out of imperfect parts."
—Urza

name: Worldfire
oracle_text: Exile all permanents. Exile all cards from all hands and graveyards. Each player's life total becomes 1.
flavor_text: Even the smallest spark may set a world ablaze.

name: Kaervek's Hex
oracle_text: Kaervek's Hex deals 1 damage to each nonblack creature and an additional 1 damage to each green creature.
flavor_text:
"If the curse does not strike you dead, question your soul."
—Kaervek

name: Planar Overlay
oracle_text: Each player chooses a land they control of each basic land type. Return those lands to their owners' hands.
flavor_text: The Phyrexians don't want to conquer Dominaria. They want to remake it.

name: Global Ruin
oracle_text: Each player chooses from the lands they control a land of each basic land type, then sacrifices the rest.
flavor_text:
"The earth shook, the sky rained fire, and it seemed the world was ending."
—Benalish refugee

name: Broadcast Takeover
oracle_text: Gain control of all artifacts your opponents control until end of turn. Untap them. They gain haste until end of turn.
flavor_text: The power of the Foot is its ability to infiltrate every system from the shadows.

name: Tune Up
oracle_text: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If it's a Vehicle, it becomes an artifact creature.
flavor_text:
"For most people? The odds would be insurmountable," Daretti said.
"But we're not most people," Pia replied.

name: Blightning
oracle_text: Blightning deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker. That player or that planeswalker's controller discards two cards.
flavor_text: While the smell of burning flesh is common in Grixis, the odor of smoldering brain matter is a rare treat.

name: Consign to Dream
oracle_text: Return target permanent to its owner's hand. If that permanent is red or green, put it on top of its owner's library instead.
flavor_text:
"Dreams are fleeting. Reality even more so."
—Oona, queen of the fae

name: Sweep Away
oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand. If that creature is attacking, you may put it on top of its owner's library instead.
flavor_text: The Roil takes many forms. It also takes many victims.

name: Light of Judgment
oracle_text: Light of Judgment deals 6 damage to target creature. Destroy up to one Equipment attached to that creature.
flavor_text:
"I was there... I saw when Kefka used his Light of Judgment to torch the village of Mobliz, far to the east."
—Tzen resident
